segments.name: Non-opioid pain therapies
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, markets, distributes and sells non-opioid pain therapies for patients and healthcare providers.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed and operated as a single business focused on the development, manufacture, marketing, distribution and sale of non-opioid pain therapies.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net product sales from selling its non-opioid pain therapies, primarily EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera°, to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Net product sales of EXPAREL were $575.1 million, $549.0 million and $538.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
